audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 50.01% WR over 8661 games with her lethal 6-and-first-item window against a dashless mage; Viktor wins side/teamfights at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart disagrees with the content chart and the packet on six of seven rows (full ran Naafiri x4 then Skill x3; packet and content say Naafiri/Skill/Skill/Skill/Naafiri/Naafiri/Viktor).
audit.why: Content whys and packet levelChart agree with each other and with the kits: her 6 (Hounds' Pursuit + The Call of the Pack) and first item are her windows; two items flip to Viktor.
audit.corrected: Full phases[1..6].side moved to match content win[1..6]; whys and ratings rewritten in the same group. win[] untouched (already correct).

audit.whatIsWrong: Three wrong ability names: Viktor's E written as Death Ray (kit: Hextech Ray), Naafiri's Q as Darkin Dagger (kit: Darkin Daggers), and her R as 'Hounds of the Hunt' (kit: Hounds' Pursuit) in four content fields. Male pronouns throughout the full layer. No cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority on names; Naafiri R 110/95/80s, W 26-18s (untargetable), E 450-range dash with pack heal; Viktor W 17-13s.
audit.corrected: All names fixed, pronouns fixed, real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Gravity Field for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: 110/95/80s — the lock-on dash starts her dive; step up only on its downtime. - Her W untargetability is 26s at rank 1: once it's spent, her pack is just minions. - Your W Gravity Field is 17s — budget it for her commit, never for poke.

edits.before: Naafiri wins level 1 with her Darkin Daggers poke and pack pressure, but from level 3 you stabilise: use Death Ray to clear her extra hounds and to poke her when she steps up to throw daggers.
